changelog: Full Lark-style music player: library, playlists, favorites, shuffle & repeat, sleep timer, playback speed
Every song splits into two tracks — vocals + music — with a live stem mixer (mute, solo, levels)
5-band equalizer with presets incl. Vocal Boost, plus WAV export for vocals, karaoke and custom mixes
Your library is saved on-device and restored automatically; multi-file import on Android
New sticky mini-player and refreshed now-playing screen
